sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 1000. Success value 100. 2x physical damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Heals 40% of max HP every 5 seconds for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Heals CP by 10% of all alliesmax CP every 5 seconds for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (7 times). Effect applied for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Grace for 120 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
-Target: yourself. Applies Skirmish for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects; [Special] fill your Unison gauge by 3 and recover 5 Cost when using an Ability; [Special] restores CP based on damage dealt. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 40000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 40000
